test_title: PYST 40: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 01 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following decides the allocation of portfolios among Indian state ministers?

options.text: Chief Justice of the High Court

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Chief Minister**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Chief Minister** is the head of the Council of Ministers in a state and plays a crucial role in the functioning of the state government.
 
• The **Governor** appoints the Chief Minister, who in turn advises the Governor on the appointment of other ministers.
 
• As per **Article 163** and **Article 164** of the **Indian Constitution**, the Chief Minister has the authority to allocate portfolios to the ministers of the state.
 
• The allocation of portfolios refers to the distribution of responsibilities to the various ministers in the Council of Ministers, such as finance, health, education, etc.
 
• The Chief Minister ensures that the distribution aligns with the expertise and efficiency of the ministers in their respective domains.
 
• This power highlights the Chief Minister's position as the primary executive authority in the state government.
 
• The Chief Minister is also accountable to the **State Legislature** for the decisions and actions taken by the Council of Ministers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Prime Minister**__

 __
 
• The **Prime Minister** is the head of the government at the national level in India.
 
• They do not have the authority to allocate portfolios for state ministers, as this function lies with the Chief Minister.
 
• The Prime Minister allocates portfolios to the Union Council of Ministers at the central level.
 
 
 
• **Governor**__
 __
 
• The **Governor** is the constitutional head of a state in India.
 
• Although the Governor formally appoints the Chief Minister and other ministers, the allocation of portfolios is done on the advice of the Chief Minister.
 
• The Governor acts as a nominal head, with real executive power vested in the Chief Minister and the Council of Ministers.
 
 
 
• **Chief Justice of the High Court**__
 
 
• The **Chief Justice of the High Court** is the head of the judiciary at the state level.
 
• They have no role in the executive or administrative functions of the state government, including the allocation of portfolios to ministers.
 
• The Chief Justice primarily handles judicial matters and ensures the smooth functioning of the High Court.
